title: DOH to distribute free condoms on World AIDS Day
summary: In line with the observance of World AIDS Day next month, the Department of Health will distribute condoms free of charge to the public through its regional offices, HIV treatment hubs, and local…

blocks.text: The DOH’s Disease Prevention and Control Bureau (DPCB) through the National HIV, AIDS, and STI Prevention and Control Program (NASPCP) will provide free condoms through the Centers for Health Development (CHD), their respective partner local government units and DOH-certified HIV treatment hubs.

MANILA, Philippines — In line with the observance of World AIDS Day next month, the Department of Health (DOH) will distribute condoms free of charge to the public through its regional offices, HIV treatment hubs, and local government units.

“The DPCB-NASPCP is making condoms available to CHDs, LGUs, and DOH-certified HIV treatment hubs for distribution, free of charge, during their planned World AIDS Day advocacy and outreach activities,” the DOH said in a Department Circular.
World AIDS Day is observed every Dec. 1.
Interested LGUs and health facilities were advised to course their requests through their respective CHDs via email at [email protected].
According to the DOH, the Philippines continues to face a rapidly growing HIV epidemic, with the number of newly diagnosed HIV cases reported each month increasing consistently from 2021 to 2025.
